blurb: Enchanted Island offers eleven rides and attractions designed especially for children aged 1 to 10. Guests can ride the historic Encanto Carousel, pedal boats across lagoons, play carnival games, and enjoy a train ride around the island. The park is free to enter; payment is only required for rides and activities.
extraNote: No deposit required · Must reserve date in advance for parties and picnics · Enchanted Island Amusement Park, Encanto Park, Phoenix, Arizona
